cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

mechanism: A directs the sequence of attempted fixes while early objects return in altered roles until their combined consequences force one practical ending.
confusable: Distinguish listing callbacks from a causal chain in which earlier details actually constrain later choices; each returning object must do work.
comparison: Wet invitation and hall key converge on entry trouble; seating displaced by cake must converge on a concrete shared consequence rather than an abstract pile of decisions.
seedUse: Read canonical key/cup/invitation and chair/cake/stool/window seeds critically; do not retain unsupported object transformations or pianist movement merely for callbacks.
